rationale: Pulp-owned removal resets: @pulp/react hands every style key that disappears from a commit back to the widget's starting value through a complete reset table (layout through a new resetStyleProperty bridge entry that restores the flex and grid style a widget had before its first layout write), re-applies surviving keys and host-config creation defaults that share a reset slot, and protects style-derived keys by the set the style source contributed. A native pixel proof replays the recorded bridge calls, and the generated bridge globals gain the resetStyleProperty entry. No design-import, Chromium, rendering, or packaging authority moves.
tests: cd packages/pulp-react && npm run build && npx vitest run
ctest --test-dir build -R 'a style toggled on and off renders like one never styled'
ctest --test-dir build -R 'resetStyleProperty restores the layout a widget was created with'
